items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: He took lots of our music, because he worked with our show, see.

ctx.x: I've heard of that. Didn't somebody else record that? Somebody made a record. Henry Williams, he took lots of our... It must have been Henry Williams. Rubberlegs.
He took lots of our music, because he worked with our show, see. I've seen that title.
Uh-huh. Uh-huh. And there was My Heartbreaking Gal, a song of mine.
